你壮着胆子挡在了前面。大孩子们嘟囔了几句，走开了。你的心跳了好久才平下来。: You summoned your courage and stood in front. The big kids muttered a bit and walked off. It took your heart a long time to calm down.
你低头走开了。那天晚上，你在被窝里想了很久。: You put your head down and walked off. That night, you lay under the covers thinking for a long time.
家里人想让你学一样才艺，问你自己喜欢什么。: The family wants you to learn something, and asks what you'd like.
你开始学乐器，起初手指总不听使唤，半年后已经能弹一首完整的曲子。: You began learning an instrument. At first your fingers wouldn't obey you, and six months later you could play a whole piece.
你开始学画画，家里的墙上很快贴满了你的作品。: You began learning to draw, and the walls at home were soon covered with your work.
你说想多玩一会儿，大人们笑着答应了。: You said you wanted more time to play, and the adults laughed and agreed.
大人在院子边上给你留了一小块地，让你自己种点东西。: The adults set aside a little patch at the edge of the yard for you to grow something yourself.
学校发了几颗种子，让大家回家种在花盆里。: The school gave out some seeds for everyone to plant in pots at home.
向日葵长得比你还高，每天早上你都要去看看它朝着哪边。: The sunflower grew taller than you, and each morning you went to see which way it faced.
秋天你摘下了第一颗小番茄，分给家里每人一小口。: In autumn you picked your first little tomato, and gave everyone in the family a small bite.
{festival}快到了，大人问你最想要什么礼物。: {festival} is near, and the adults ask what present you want most.
你收到了一本厚厚的故事书，翻开第一页就舍不得放下。: You got a thick storybook, and couldn't put it down once you opened the first page.
你抱着新玩具睡了好几个晚上，连吃饭都要带着。: You slept with the new toy for several nights, and even brought it to meals.
那天全家人一起出门，你记住了每个人的笑脸。: The whole family went out that day, and you remembered everyone's smiling faces.
第一次试着封斋: Trying to fast for the first time
斋月到了，你想和大人们一样试着白天不吃东西。家里人说，量力而行就好。: Ramadan has come, and you want to try going without food by day as the adults do. The family says to do what you can.
试着坚持一整天: Try to last the whole day
你坚持到了日落，开斋时喝下的那口水，是你喝过最甜的。全家人都夸你长大了。: You lasted until sunset, and that first sip of water at dusk was the sweetest you'd ever had. The whole family said you'd grown up.
你坚持到了中午，大人笑着说：“明年再多坚持一会儿。”: You lasted until noon, and the adults laughed: "A little longer next year."
排灯节就要到了，家里人分配任务，问你想做什么。: Diwali is coming, and the family is handing out jobs. What do you want to do?
你小心地把一盏盏油灯摆在窗台上，夜里整条街都亮了起来。: You carefully set out lamp after lamp on the windowsill, and at night the whole street lit up.
你和伙伴们在巷子里放烟花，笑声比烟花还响。: You and your friends let off fireworks in the lane, and your laughter was louder than the fireworks.
发烧了还想上学: Feverish but wanting to go to school
你发烧了，可明天学校有你期待了很久的活动。: You have a fever, but tomorrow the school has an event you've looked forward to for ages.
你乖乖在家睡了一天，烧退了，第二天又活蹦乱跳。: You stayed home and slept all day. The fever broke, and you were bouncing around again the next day.
你硬撑着去了学校，回家后又烧了起来，多躺了两天。: You dragged yourself to school. The fever came back at home, and you spent two more days in bed.
放学路上，一只瘦瘦的小猫跟着你走了很远。: On the way home from school, a skinny little kitten follows you for a long way.
你抱着小猫回家，求了大人好久。小猫留了下来，名字叫{petname}。: You carried the kitten home and begged the adults for ages. It stayed, and its name was {petname}.
你把面包掰碎喂给它，第二天放学，它又在老地方等你。: You crumbled some bread for it. The next day after school, it was waiting in the same spot.
图书馆可以给小朋友办借书证了。: The library now gives cards to children.
每个周末你都会去图书馆，借回一摞书，再在约定的日子还回去。: Every weekend you went to the library, borrowed a stack of books, and brought them back on the agreed day.
你偶尔去一次，专挑有很多图画的书。: You went now and then, picking the books with lots of pictures.
{granny}又要讲她年轻时候的故事了，可伙伴们正在门外喊你。: {granny} is about to tell stories of her youth again, but your friends are calling you from outside.
你搬了个小板凳坐在她身边，听她讲那些很久以前的事。很多年后，你还记得她讲故事时的: You brought a little stool, sat beside her, and heard about those long-ago things. Many years later, you still remembered how she looked telling them.
你答应她明天再听，一溜烟跑了出去。: You promised to listen tomorrow, and shot out the door.
你和{sibling}都想玩同一个玩具，眼看就要吵起来了。: You and {sibling} both want the same toy, and a fight is about to start.
你把玩具让了出去。{sibling}愣了一下，晚上把自己的点心分了你一半。: You gave up the toy. {sibling} looked surprised, and shared half their snack with you that night.
你们定好每人玩一会儿，还用沙漏计时。: You agreed that each would play for a while, timing it with an hourglass.
去找大人告状: Tell on them to an adult
大人把玩具收走了，谁也没玩成。: The adult took the toy away, and no one got to play.
夏天到了，家里人觉得你该学会游泳了。: It's summer, and the family thinks it's time you learned to swim.
你从抱着浮板发抖，到能一口气游完一个来回，只用了一个夏天。: You went from shivering on a float to swimming a full lap in one breath, all in one summer.
你在浅水区扑腾了一个夏天，学会了憋气。: You splashed about in the shallows all summer, and learned to hold your breath.
科学课的作业是在家做一个小实验。: Your science homework is to do a small experiment at home.
小苏打和醋一碰，泡沫“噗”地涌了出来，你兴奋得叫了起来。: Baking soda met vinegar and the foam came whooshing out, and you shouted with excitement.
你趴在地上看了一个星期蚂蚁搬家，记了满满三页笔记。: You lay on the ground watching ants move house for a week, and filled three pages of notes.
学校停课了，老师在屏幕那头讲课，屏幕这头只有你一个人。: School has closed. The teacher talks on one side of the screen, and on the other side there's only you.
你每天准时坐到屏幕前，笔记记得比在教室里还认真。: You sat down at the screen on time each day, and took better notes than in the classroom.
你把老师的画面缩到角落，偷偷玩起了游戏。期末考试时你有点慌。: You shrank the teacher's window to a corner and secretly played games. You panicked a little at exam time.
学校给每个孩子配了一个 AI 学习伙伴，它什么问题都能回答。: The school gives each child an AI study partner, which can answer any question.
你每天都要问它十几个“为什么”，它从不嫌烦。你的问题越问越深。: You asked it a dozen "why"s each day, and it never got tired. Your questions went deeper and deeper.
你更喜欢举手问老师，老师总会多讲一些书上没有的东西。: You preferred raising your hand to ask the teacher, who always told you more than the book did.
家里答应送你一只“小狗”，可以选会说话的机器狗，也可以去领养一只真的。: The family has promised you a "puppy". You can choose a talking robot dog, or adopt a real one.
机器狗会背古诗、会讲笑话，还从来不掉毛。: The robot dog could recite poems and tell jokes, and never shed a hair.
你们从救助站领回一只小狗，取名{petname}。它咬坏了你一只拖鞋，你一点也不: You brought a puppy home from the shelter and named it {petname}. It chewed up one of your slippers, and you weren't mad at all.
今天是赶集的日子，大人要去集上卖东西。: Today is market day, and the adults are going to sell things.
你帮大人吆喝、找零，算账比大人还快，收摊时得了一块糖。: You helped the adults call out to customers and give change, did sums faster than they did, and got a sweet when you packed up.
你在集上逛了一整天，看耍把戏的、卖小鸡的，样样都新鲜。: You wandered the market all day, watching the performers and the chick sellers, and all of it was new.
去学校要走很远的路，天不亮就得出门。: School is a long walk away, and you have to set off before dawn.
你们一路说说笑笑，远路好像也没那么远了。: You chatted and laughed along the way, and the long road didn't seem so long.
你一边走一边背课文，到学校时已经背得滚瓜烂熟。: You recited your lessons as you walked, and knew them by heart when you got there.
你的生日快到了，家里人问你想怎么过。: Your birthday is coming, and the family asks how you want to spend it.
同学们挤满了客厅，你吹蜡烛时许了一个谁也没告诉的愿望。: Classmates filled the living room, and as you blew out the candles you made a wish you told no one.
一家人围在一起吃了顿好的，你收到了一个大大的拥抱。: The family gathered for a good meal, and you got a big hug.
长大想做什么: What to be when you grow up
老师让大家写一篇作文：《长大以后》。: The teacher has everyone write an essay: "When I Grow Up".
你写想当科学家，造一艘能飞到星星上的飞船。: You wrote that you wanted to be a scientist, and build a ship that could fly to the stars.
你写想当医生，让生病的人都快点好起来。: You wrote that you wanted to be a doctor, and make all sick people better soon.
你写想开一家小店，卖全世界最好吃的点心。: You wrote that you wanted to open a little shop, selling the tastiest snacks in the world.
中秋节到了，家里买了一盒月饼，你最先挑。: It's the Mid-Autumn Festival, the family bought a box of mooncakes, and you get to pick first.
你挑走了最喜欢的那一块，咬一口，满嘴都是甜。: You took your favourite, and one bite filled your mouth with sweetness.
你把盒子先递给了爷爷奶奶。大人们夸你懂事，你也很开心。: You passed the box to your grandparents first. The adults praised you, and you felt happy too.
学校要排一出节日小话剧，老师问你想演什么。: The school is putting on a little holiday play, and the teacher asks what you want to play.
你背了一个星期的台词，上台时一句也没忘，台下的家长们都在鼓掌。: You learned your lines for a week and didn't forget one on stage, and the parents all clapped.
你演一棵树，从头站到尾，偷偷朝台下的家人眨眼睛。: You played a tree, standing from start to finish, and secretly winked at your family in the audience.
你学会了骑车，想和伙伴们骑去城边的河边。: You've learned to ride a bike, and want to cycle with your friends to the river at the edge of town.
你告诉了大人路线和回家时间，痛痛快快地玩了一下午。: You told the adults your route and when you'd be back, and had a wonderful afternoon.
你在院子里一圈一圈地骑，练会了单手扶车把。: You rode round and round the yard, and learned to steer with one hand.
你认识的字越来越多，开始能自己读完一本小书了。: You know more and more words, and can read a little book by yourself.
你每天睡前读上几页，书架上的书慢慢多了起来。: You read a few pages before bed each day, and the bookshelf slowly filled up.
让大人读给你听: Have an adult read to you
你还是喜欢窝在大人怀里听故事。: You still liked curling up in an adult's arms to hear a story.
老师发了彩笔，让大家画一画自己最想要的东西。: The teacher hands out coloured pens, and asks everyone to draw what they want most.
你画了一座有院子的房子，门口站着你和家人。老师把它贴在了墙上。: You drew a house with a yard, with you and your family standing at the door. The teacher put it on the wall.
你画了一所很大的学校，窗户里的每个孩子都在笑。: You drew a huge school, with a smiling child at every window.
家里同意给你买手机，但要先“约法三章”。: The family has agreed to buy you a phone, but first wants to set some rules.
答应晚上交手机: Agree to hand it in at night
你答应每晚十点把手机交给大人。一开始很不习惯，后来睡得反而更好了。: You agreed to hand your phone to the adults at ten each night. It was strange at first, and later you slept better for it.
保证不耽误学习: Promise it won't affect your studies
你拍着胸脯保证不耽误学习，期末成绩也确实没掉。: You swore it wouldn't affect your studies, and your end-of-term marks didn't drop.
你说再等等，先把心思放在学习上。: You said you'd wait, and keep your mind on your studies first.
课后，几个朋友躲在墙角抽烟，有人递了一根给你。: After class, a few friends are smoking in a corner, and someone hands you one.
你学着他们的样子吸了一口，呛得直咳嗽，大家都笑了。从那以后，你口袋里常常揣着一包: You copied them and took a puff, coughing and choking, and everyone laughed. From then on, you often had a pack in your pocket.
你笑着摆摆手：“我不抽。”没有人再劝你。: You smiled and waved your hand: "I don't smoke." No one pressed you.
学校的社团开始招新，海报贴满了走廊。: School clubs are recruiting, and posters fill the corridors.
你加入了{sport}队，每天放学后训练，身上晒出了印子，也交到了一群好兄弟好姐: You joined the {sport} team and trained after school each day. You got a tan line and a great bunch of teammates.
你加入了文学社，第一次把自己写的诗印在了校刊上。: You joined the literature club, and for the first time saw a poem of yours printed in the school magazine.
你加入了编程社，写出第一个能动的小程序时，你在机房里叫出了声。: You joined the programming club. When your first little program moved, you shouted out loud in the computer room.
你发现自己总会不由自主地看向班上的一个人。: You find your eyes keep drifting to someone in your class.
你写了一张小纸条，又改了七八遍。对方回了一个笑脸，你高兴了一整天。: You wrote a little note and changed it seven or eight times. They answered with a smiley face, and you were happy all day.
你把这份心动藏在日记里，很多年后翻到，还会笑出声来。: You hid the crush in your diary. Coming across it many years later, you still laughed out loud.
把心思放回学习: Put your mind back on studying
你深吸一口气，把心思拉回了课本上。: You took a deep breath and pulled your mind back to your textbook.
暑假到了，你想找点事情做。家里人问你的打算。: It's the summer holidays and you want something to do. The family asks about your plans.
你在一家小店打了一个暑假的工，第一次知道挣钱有多不容易。: You worked at a little shop all summer, and learned for the first time how hard it is to earn money.
你报了补习班，暑假和上学一样忙。: You signed up for tutoring, and the holidays were as busy as term time.
你睡到自然醒，看完了一直想看的几本书。: You slept until you woke, and read those books you'd always wanted to read.
周末，朋友们约你一起通宵打游戏。: At the weekend, friends invite you to game all night.
你们一直玩到天亮，第二天你睡到了下午，晚上又睡不着。: You played until dawn, slept until the next afternoon, and then couldn't sleep at night.
你十一点准时下线，朋友们笑你“养生”，你也跟着笑。: You logged off at eleven sharp. Your friends laughed at you for being so health-conscious, and you laughed along.
{exam}越来越近，班上好多同学都在上补习班。: {exam} is getting closer, and many classmates are in tutoring.
你每天放学后再去补习班，回家时街上的灯都亮了。成绩往前挪了一截，人也瘦了一圈。: You went to tutoring after school each day, and the street lights were on by the time you got home. Your marks moved up, and you got thinner.
你给自己定了复习计划，一项一项地划掉。: You made a revision plan and crossed things off one by one.
你和几个同学结成学习小组，互相出题、互相打气。: You formed a study group with a few classmates, setting each other questions and cheering each other on.
学校号召大家利用周末去做志愿服务。: The school urges everyone to volunteer at weekends.
你陪养老院的老人们聊天、读报，一位奶奶记住了你的名字，每次都拉着你的手。: You talked with the residents and read them the paper. One old woman remembered your name, and always took your hand.
你在图书馆把一排排书摆整齐，顺便发现了好几本想读的书。: You lined up rows of books at the library, and found several you wanted to read.
为了一件小事，你和家里大人吵了起来，摔门进了房间。: Over something small, you argued with the adults and slammed your bedroom door.
你在门口站了很久，终于开口说了声“对不起”。大人眼圈红了，说他们也有不对。: You stood at the door for a long time, and finally said "sorry". The adult's eyes reddened, and they said they'd been wrong too.
冷战几天: Don't speak for a few days
你们冷战了好几天，最后在饭桌上若无其事地和好了。: You didn't speak for days, and finally made up at the dinner table as if nothing had happened.
你把想说的话写在纸上，悄悄放在他们的枕头边。第二天早餐桌上，多了一个你爱吃的煎蛋: You wrote what you wanted to say on paper and quietly left it by their pillow. At breakfast the next day, there was an extra fried egg, just how you like it.
你想换个发型，在镜子前比画了好久。: You want a new hairstyle, and spend ages trying things in the mirror.
新发型让你在学校里引起了小小的轰动，你假装不在意，心里却有点得意。: The new hairstyle caused a small stir at school. You pretended not to care, and felt rather pleased.
你最后还是剪了老样子，舒服就好。: In the end you got the same old cut. Comfortable is good.
同学们都在网上分享生活，你也想开个账号。: Your classmates all share their lives online, and you want an account too.
开一个记录生活: Open one to record your life
你开始在网上记录日常，偶尔收到几个陌生人的点赞，也收到过让你难过的评论。: You began recording your days online. Sometimes strangers liked your posts, and sometimes comments hurt you.
你觉得那里太吵，还是更喜欢面对面说话。: You thought it was too noisy, and still preferred talking face to face.
一到晚上，你就忍不住刷短视频，一刷就停不下来。: At night, you can't resist short videos, and can't stop once you start.
你给自己设了半小时的提醒，时间一到就放下手机。: You set yourself a half-hour reminder, and put the phone down when it rang.
你常常刷到凌晨，第二天上课眼皮直打架。: You often scrolled until the small hours, and your eyelids drooped in class the next day.
同学们都在用 AI 写作文，你也打开了对话框。: Your classmates are all using AI to write essays, and you open the chat box too.
只用它查资料: Only use it to look things up
你让 AI 帮你找资料、挑错别字，文章还是自己一个字一个字写的。: You had AI find material and spot typos, and wrote the essay yourself word by word.
作文很快交上去了，可考试时你对着题目发了半天呆。: The essay went in fast, but in the exam you stared blankly at the question for a long time.
你坚持自己写，熬了几个晚上，写出来的东西却是自己的。: You insisted on writing it yourself. It took a few late nights, but what you wrote was your own.
学校组织春游，要自己找同伴分组。: The school is holding a spring outing, and you have to form your own groups.
你们一路说笑，拍了一大堆傻乎乎的照片。: You chatted and laughed the whole way, and took a pile of silly photos.
你和几个不太熟的同学分到一组，一天下来，多了几个新朋友。: You ended up with a few classmates you barely knew, and by the end of the day you had a few new friends.
饭钱怎么用: How to use your lunch money
家里每周给你一点饭钱，你可以自己安排。: The family gives you a little lunch money each week, for you to manage.
你每天少吃一份零食，月底给自己买了一本想了很久的书。: You skipped a snack each day, and at the end of the month bought a book you'd long wanted.
你和同学们一起去学校门口的小店，边吃边聊，一天里最快乐的就是这一会儿。: You went to the little shop by the school gate with your classmates, eating and talking. It was the happiest part of the day.
体育老师说，坚持晨跑一个学期，体能会大不一样。: The PE teacher says that if you keep up morning runs for a term, your fitness will be very different.
你每天早上跑三公里，从气喘吁吁到越跑越轻松。: You ran three kilometres every morning, going from gasping to running easily.
你周末和朋友们打球，跑得满头大汗。: You played ball with friends at weekends, running until you were dripping with sweat.
老师以为是你在课上捣乱，当着全班批评了你。: The teacher thought you were the one messing about in class, and scolded you in front of everyone.
下课后你去办公室把事情说清楚，老师向你道了歉。: After class you went to the office and explained, and the teacher apologised to you.
算了，忍着: Forget it, put up with it
你憋着一口气没说话，回家后一个人生了半天闷气。: You held it in and said nothing, and sulked by yourself for ages at home.
学校选拔学生参加竞赛，老师觉得你可以试试。: The school is selecting students for a competition, and the teacher thinks you could try.

你可以随机降生，也可以自定义出生；在人生的关键时刻，可以选择给出的选项，也可以写: You can be born at random or customise your birth. At key moments you can pick from the options or write what you want to do. When AI is available, it weaves later storylines from each of your earlier choices, so new decisions grow out of your own past. When it isn't, the built-in engine still remembers your choices and lets them shape later life.

个人系数由健康值、家庭与收入位置、慢性病、吸烟等习惯组成，并经过归一化：全体人口: The personal factor combines health, family and income position, chronic illness and habits such as smoking, and is normalised so the population average is about 1. Simulated lifespans therefore match UN data. It is capped between 0.25 and 6 times.
2024 年及以前的生命表已经包含真实发生的危机死亡（如新冠疫情与战争），历史事: Life tables up to 2024 already include real crisis deaths (such as COVID-19 and wars), so historical events aren't counted again and only inform cause of death and story. From {0}, world line scenarios, random shocks and future events multiply in.
死因按世界卫生组织的年龄段 × 收入组死因构成抽取，并按处境调整：战乱提高暴力死: Cause of death is drawn from WHO data by age band and income group, then adjusted for your situation: war raises violent deaths, epidemics raise infectious disease, and smoking raises heart disease, cancer and respiratory illness.
收入 = 人均 GDP × 居民消费占比 ×（就业者约 1.5 倍）× 由基尼系: Income = GDP per capita × household consumption share × (about 1.5 for the employed) × your percentile position in a log-normal distribution set by the Gini coefficient. Unemployment risk comes from unemployment and youth unemployment rates; retirement age comes from each country's rules.
所有金额以 2021 年国际元（购买力平价、扣除通胀）计算，显示时按 2021: All amounts are calculated in 2021 international dollars (PPP, inflation-adjusted) and shown in local currency at 2021 prices. Savings and investments use real annual asset returns for 2000–2025 and are simulated by world line afterwards.
入学与升学概率来自中学与高等教育毛入学率，并受家庭条件、城乡、性别与时代影响；关: School and university odds come from secondary and tertiary gross enrolment, and are shaped by family, urban or rural life, sex and era. Key exams come from each country's system. Marriage odds are calibrated to median first-marriage age, and births to total fertility and mean age at childbearing.
迁徙只通过抉择、故事线与事件发生，可行性取决于你的钱、学历、目的地与常见的迁移路: Migration only happens through decisions, storylines and events. Whether it's possible depends on your money, education, destination and common routes.

AI 负责出生故事、每个抉择的情境与选项、你自由行动的结果、由选择引出的后续故事: AI handles birth stories, each decision's scene and options, the results of your free actions, later storylines drawn from your choices, and the final biography and epitaph. It reads your situation, recent experience, past choices, your country's real numbers and that year's world events, so new decisions grow out of your own past.
所有 AI 输出都经过校验：数值被限制在合理范围，不存在的国家代码会被丢弃，不可: All AI output is validated: values are limited to reasonable ranges, country codes that don't exist are dropped, and the built-in engine takes over at once when AI is unavailable. The built-in engine has its own event library and storyline templates, so a whole life can be played without AI.
